title: Trader Diary: Watching BTC at $82.5k like a Netflix cliffhanger
content:
- 9 PM: “Just a 0.5% pullback, I’ll add more leverage.”
- 9:05 PM: Chart flips to a red ocean, heart rate spikes to 180 BPM.
- 9:07 PM: “I’m fine, I’m fine,” while the phone vibrates with liquidation alerts.
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before you get that “I’m fine” vibe—your future self will thank you.
question: Who else just turned their living room into a trading pit at 9 PM? Drop your worst FOMO story 👇
